source_prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork of a pale bald androgynous figure with wide eyes breaking through a torn spiral notebook page. Their torso dissolves into a flowing blue cosmic river filled with knights on horseback carrying flags, floating books, and blue flowers. Bright yellow energy rays burst from the figure's head.
